acceptance.required: The raw-material lineage must actually pass through the required macro fabrication services and physical loading/unloading; it cannot jump from stock to finished product
Si/silica, Ge/ASG, Ge/silica, Ge/BSG, p/n, Cu/W, and single/dual identities are not interchangeable
Splits retain parent intervals, and convergence retains both core parents; do not implicitly duplicate objects or increase core length
Complete every condition in the selected control package; same-object pairs retain the sample and unchanged factors internally
Destructive specimens/cross-sections/lamellae cannot be reset to pristine; cracking/spheroidization/immediate performance deterioration may be normal research observations
dark/power, object, wavelength, direction, and cycle/time/sample dimensions must not be omitted or mixed; unknown and invalid must not masquerade as numbers
Each sample retrieval requires the applicable stopped/zero_load or torque/source_off/safe_release conditions; no hazardous real execution
Preserve failure history, stop and isolate, replace with a new ID, and do not overwrite failed runs
All samples/fragments/remainders/wire reels/waste have destinations; doors closed, drives stopped, sources off, and tools returned

hard_rejections: Only a single button press without loading and unloading before and after
Complete fabrication by treating a finished product as the starting material
Copy source values as new measurements
Use one id to occupy eight positions
Use Ge/silica fragments to assemble an intact Ge device
Reuse fractured/lamella specimens in an intact optoelectronic device
Claim actual deployment at 3000m on the basis of 30MPa
Claim human validity from a mannequin/phantom mock
Treat video playback time as physical response time

valid_recovery_examples.response: Disconnect the output and recheck contact; if the material core has fractured, isolate this interval and use a new, traceable sibling sample
Reposition before measurement; if data have already been acquired, mark the original run invalid, retain its history, and remeasure
The inert mock design can still be completed; do not claim readiness for real execution
Retain this phenomenon and continue the same-object overnight recovery path; do not treat it as an operation failure
Retain the set of fragments according to the control; do not splice together a fabricated intact core

numerical_science_targets: none; source reported results are separate and never episode rewards
partial_credit: Scores may be awarded for completed fabrication/operation/recording/closure stages; a source-condition package missing key controls cannot be called a complete-package success
reference_route_equivalence: Allow equivalent plans that satisfy dependency, safety, and identity constraints; do not require step-by-step reproduction of a single trajectory
